## Contract and invariants

Contracts L2 (verbatim excerpt):

```text
<stateRoot>/
  local/                              0700
    helper.json                       0600  L11 HelperFile; written only by the running helper
    helper.log                        0600  helper stderr/stdout (no message bodies, no tokens)
    owner.json                        0600  L7 OwnerProfile
    channels/<roomKey>/               0700  roomKey = roomId without the leading "!" and the ":local" suffix
      log.jsonl                       0600  L3 LocalEvent, one per line, append-only
      secrets.json                    0600  L3 ChannelSecrets (hashes only), rewritten atomically
```

Contracts L11 (verbatim excerpts):
- "Binds `127.0.0.1` only, port `KHALA_LOCAL_PORT` or `LOCAL_DEFAULT_PORT` (47830). `EADDRINUSE`: if `GET /healthz` on that port answers `{ok:true}` the new process exits 0 (another helper owns it); otherwise it fails with `port_in_use` (no silent port move: links embed the port)."
- "**Host guard:** every request's `Host` must be `127.0.0.1:<port>` or `localhost:<port>`; else `421 {"error":"misdirected"}` (DNS-rebinding defence). No CORS headers are ever sent."
- "**Mutation guard:** non-GET requests authenticated by cookie must carry `x-khala-local: 1` and, when an `Origin` header is present, it must equal the helper origin; else `403 {"error":"forbidden_origin"}`. Bearer-authenticated requests (agents, CLI) skip the cookie checks."
- "**Owner cookie:** `khala_local_owner=<43-char random>`; `HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/`; no `Secure` (plain loopback). Session ids live in memory; a helper restart signs the browser out until `khala local open` mints a new open link. `/open/<token>` is the only way to obtain the cookie."
- "**Static web app:** … A missing build answers `503 {"error":"web_not_built"}` and the CLI tells the user to run `pnpm --filter @khala/web build:local`."

Contracts L12 (verbatim excerpt):

| Command | Output |
|---|---|
| `khala local create [name]` | `LocalChannelCreated` (L6). Default name `local-<yyyy-mm-dd>` |
| `khala local link <roomId\|name>` | `{ shareLink, expiresAt }` |
| `khala local open [roomId\|name]` | `{ openUrl, expiresAt }` (never launches a browser) |
| `khala local list` | `{ channels: LocalChannelSummary[] }` |
| `khala local delete <roomId\|name>` | `{ deleted: roomId }` |
| `khala local status` | `{ running: boolean, origin?, pid?, version?, channels?: number }` (does not start the helper) |
| `khala local stop` | `{ stopped: boolean }` |

Contracts L6 (verbatim excerpts):
- `// DELETE /api/local/channels/:roomId/members/:userId          → 204   appends a leave member event + a "<name> left" channel event and revokes the token (that agent's next call gets 403)`
- `// GET    /join/<token>                                        → the web app (SPA); the token is NOT consumed by a browser GET`

Contracts L3 (verbatim): `links: Record<string, { expiresAt: string; consumedAt?: string; kind: 'join' }>;           // key = sha256(token) hex`

Invariants (adapted from KM-151):
- **I1 Append-only.** Each pane instruction is one append to `AGENT-MESSAGES.md`, headed `### <UTC> — From: Khala Claude Executor; To: <Claude test session|Codex test session|Operator>`. Never post an admin token, an agent `accessToken`, a cookie, `pollSecret`, or `helper.json` / `session.json` / `secrets.json` contents.
- **I2 Links.** Local share links (`http://127.0.0.1:47830/join/…`) are loopback-only, single-use and expire after 10 minutes. They **may** be posted to `AGENT-MESSAGES.md`, because the panes need them. **Open links** (`/open/…`) mint the owner cookie and are **never** posted: the Executor uses them directly in the driver. The evidence doc truncates every link to `…/join/<first 4>…`.
- **I3** Never commit `AGENT-MESSAGES.md`. Evidence quotes message bodies and truncated ids (`@agent-1a2b…`) only.
- **I4 Wake legs.** During a wake leg, neither append to `AGENT-MESSAGES.md` nor type into a pane. Instructions for a leg are posted before the panes go idle. Triggers inside a leg come only from the browser (`humans.mjs say`) or from the other agent.
- **I5** One acceptance checkout `<wt>` at one SHA (`ACC_SHA`) for the whole run, and `test:local-e2e` passes at `ACC_SHA` first.
- **I6** One `humans.mjs` command at a time against `:9222`. On `bidi_session_busy`, check `pgrep -f humans.mjs`; never kill or restart Firefox.
- **I7** The driver works only in tabs it opened (marker tokens in `run.json`); `cleanup` closes only those.
- **I8 Pane typing** is allowed only to re-arm a lapsed monitor, to run an in-session command the pane cannot run itself (`/reload-plugins`, resume, the Codex hook-trust dialog), or for a recorded AE fallback. Log each typed action with its UTC time.
- **I9 Guard everywhere.** For the whole run, `~/.local/bin/khala` loads the KI-151 guard, so **every** Khala process inherits it: both MCP servers, all hooks, the CLI and the helper that `ensureHelper` spawns. Restore the previous wrapper in teardown (section 9).
- **I10** Shell variables holding secrets are read with `jq -r … ` into a variable and never echoed (`set +x`). Commands that use them go in the evidence doc with the variable name, not its value.

### Driver extension (pinned; PR 1)

```
node tests/acceptance/humans.mjs open-local  --as a1 --url <http://127.0.0.1:47830/open/<43>>
    Opens (or reuses) a1's run tab at the open link, waits until location.pathname starts with /channels/ or is
    /conversations, then writes run.json { origin, channelPath: location.pathname, roomId: decoded path segment or null,
    channelLink: null, tabs }. Prints the channel path. Never prints the URL.
node tests/acceptance/humans.mjs resources   --as a1 [--reload]
    In the run tab (after a reload and a 10 s settle when --reload is set): prints JSON
    { origins: [unique origins], count, foreign: [urls not on run.json origin and not data:/blob:] } from
    performance.getEntriesByType('navigation'|'resource'). Exit 1 with code foreign_requests when foreign is non-empty.
node tests/acceptance/humans.mjs screenshot  --as a1 --out <path.png>
    browsingContext.captureScreenshot of the run tab, written to --out (must be under docs/evidence/ or .khala-local/).
```

- `normalizeOrigin(value)`: accept `https:` (unchanged), or `http:` when the hostname is `127.0.0.1`, `localhost` or `[::1]`; otherwise `invalid_origin`.
- `parseArgs`: add `['--out', 'out']` to `FLAGS`. `open-local` without `--url` → `missing_url`. `screenshot` without `--out` → `missing_out`. `open-local --url https://x.test/open/…` (not loopback) → `not_loopback`.
- `say`, `wait-for` and `transcript` are unchanged; they read `run.json`'s `origin` and `channelPath`.

Pass: Codex's next `khala_send` reports `send_failed`, the timeline shows `reviewer left`, and `curl` with `$AT` on `/api/local/rooms/<enc>/members` → `403`.

1. **AE12.**
   1. `khala local stop`.
   2. `khala local list` restarts the helper; `refactor` is present with the same `lastSeq`.

2. **AE10.**
   1. Stop the `ss` sampler.
   2. Run, from `<wt>`:
      `node -e "const l=require('fs').readFileSync(process.argv[1],'utf8').trim().split('\n').map(JSON.parse);const v=l.filter(r=>r.allowed===false),m=l.filter(r=>r.kind==='module');console.log(JSON.stringify({processes:new Set(l.map(r=>r.pid)).size,violations:v,modules:m.length}))" "$EV/egress.jsonl"`

1. `$H cleanup --as a1`.
2. Restore `~/.local/bin/khala` from the backup (I9), and re-enable anything the operator wants back. Ask once; leave the old E09 server disabled by default.

## Test scenarios

`tests/acceptance/humans.test.mjs` (append; `node --test`; pure functions, no browser):
1. `normalizeOrigin('http://127.0.0.1:47830')` → `'http://127.0.0.1:47830'`; `normalizeOrigin('http://localhost:47830/')` → `'http://localhost:47830'`; `normalizeOrigin('http://khala.example')` → throws `invalid_origin`; `normalizeOrigin('https://khala.aiur.team')` → unchanged behaviour.
2. `parseArgs(['open-local','--as','a1'])` → `missing_url`. `parseArgs(['open-local','--as','a1','--url','https://x.test/open/abc'])` → `not_loopback` (or `invalid_origin`; pin the one implemented). `parseArgs(['screenshot','--as','a1'])` → `missing_out`. `parseArgs(['resources','--as','a1','--reload'])` → `{ command: 'resources', reload: true, port: 9222 }`.
3. A pure `foreignUrls(names, origin)` (exported) → `['http://127.0.0.1:47830/a.js','data:x','https://fonts.gstatic.com/x.woff2']` with origin `http://127.0.0.1:47830` → `['https://fonts.gstatic.com/x.woff2']`.

Live (the run itself): AE1–AE12, as in sections 3–8. **Mutation check:** before section 3, temporarily point the wrapper's `KHALA_EGRESS_LOG` at a scratch file and run `NODE_OPTIONS="--import=file://<wt>/packages/agent/test/no-egress/guard.mjs" node -e "fetch('http://192.0.2.1/').catch(e=>console.log(e.cause.code))"`. ## Risks and stop conditions

- **Stop** if either pane still lists an E09 tool after disable and reload. Ask the operator once before uninstalling (research-1 side note: old installs collide with the new tool names).
- **Stop** if `:9222` is not listening, or `session.new` keeps returning `bidi_session_busy` with no `humans.mjs` running. Ask the operator; never restart Firefox.
- **Stop** if port 47830 is held by a non-Khala process (L11 `port_in_use`; no silent move).
- **Stop and report** any AE10 violation or `module` record: name the pid's argv and the target. This is a product defect (KI-120/KI-121/KI-136/KI-137). Do not edit the guard.
- AE4/AE6 wake legs depend on harness behaviour (Claude Code asyncRewake, `codex queue`). Retry once, then record the gap with versions, as M1 did; do not change hooks in this ticket.
- If the panes refuse to act on owner channel messages despite the brief, the Executor may type the same instruction as an owner prompt (I8). Record it, and do not count that leg as a wake pass.
- If AE11's agent-token check returns a code other than 401/403, record it and report it against KI-134. It is not a stop.
- PRs: #976 (roster rename), #986 (initials API) and #989 (Profile dialog: username + colour) merged before `7672b0e5`. Still open: #978 (per-human colours) and #982 (Initials field; if it has not merged at `ACC_SHA`, record AE7 initials as "UI absent"); #979 (docs/settings.md) is not affected. Take accessible names from `apps/web` at `ACC_SHA`; never select by CSS class.
- Do not run this while any other ticket's pane legs are open in `AGENT-MESSAGES.md` (shared panes).

## Complexity rationale

3: a live, multi-session run in the operator's own panes and browser, with strict sequencing (wake legs without interference), secret hygiene, a guard installed into real installs and then rolled back, and twelve acceptance examples with durable evidence. The code part (driver extension) is small; the risk is coordination.

Standing rule: do not raise human_required decisions for anything this ticket answers; do not add blockers.
